claim: Knowledge reuse (using another agent's commit as parent) is associated with higher improvement rates in multi-agent co-evolution, especially on advanced tasks.
falsifier: Replicate the analysis on a new set of tasks, measuring improvement rates for attempts that reuse knowledge versus those that do not, and compare the effect size across task difficulty levels.

conditions: tasks include standard and advanced optimization problems
knowledge access is measured via commit parentage
exclusions: limited to the reported tasks, model backends, and experimental conditions; the association may vary with task difficulty and infrastructure

title: Knowledge reuse–attempt improvement rate principle
